features: Parameter-driven threat evaluation (driver_number, rival_number, gap_s, driver_compound, rival_compound, driver_tyre_age, rival_tyre_age, tyre_age_delta)
Graceful fallback to live race_state.drivers for omitted parameters
Automatic P1 and trailing P2 pairing or grid relative position lookup
Strict uppercase compound validation (SOFT, MEDIUM, HARD) with case-insensitive normalization
Positive driver number validation and duplicate driver rejection
Graceful degraded empty state handling returning HTTP 200 with reason='no_active_drivers' or 'no_trailing_rival'
